spans.s: शो, † i. 4, श्य (the original form was अश् + य; cf. Lat. acies, acus, acer, acidus; ἀκή, ἀκμή, ἄκρος, ἀκόνη, ἄκων; Goth. aqvizi; A.S. acas; Sskr. अश्र, अश्रि, अश्रु, अश्मन्, अश्व, अष्ट्र, etc.), Par.; ved. ii. 3, शिशा, शिशी, Par. Ātm. To sharpen,

= Rigv. v. 9, 5 (cf. शि).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. शात.
 1. Sharpened, sharp,

; feeble. n. Joy, happiness.
 II. शित.
 1. Sharpened, sharp,

. Thin, emaciated.
 3. Feeble.
 --With the prep. आ आ, ii. 3, To incite,

= Rigv. vii. 16, 6.
 --With नि नि,
 I. निशात, Sharpened, sharp, Bhāg.

; polished, burnished.
 II. निशित, Sharpened, sharp,

; figurat., Pañc. i. d. 201. n. Iron.
 --Comp.
 --With सम् सम्, संशित,
 1. Certain, certified, established.
 2. Completed, finished,

; 45, 16 (cf. संशित-व्रत).
 3. Completing, attentive in completing, Johns.

.
 --Cf. also (see above), ἀκωκή, ἀκρέμων, ἀκριϐής, ὄκρις, ἄκανος, ἄκανθα, ἄκορνα, ὀξύς (i. e. ὀκ + τυ), ὄξος, ἄχωρ, (i. e. ἀκ + ϝαν), ἄχυρον, ἄχερδος, αἰχμή; Lat. aculeus, cătus (= शात), tri-que + trus, cos, cautes, citus (= शित), probably ciere, cio, cieo (= श्यामि); Goth. ahana, probably O.H.G. hvezjan; A.S. hwettan (a denomin.); Goth. hvôtjan.

सो, i. 4, स्य (probably akin to 2. अस्, of which the base of the present is अस्य), Par. To destroy.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. सित, Finished, completed, destroyed; see s. v.
 --With the prep. अव अव,
 1. To let fly, Rigv. i. 104, 1.
 2. To fail,

.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. सायय, To cause to be completed,

. To be able, Śiś. 9, 76.
 3. To determine,

. To reflect, Śāk. d. 115, v. r.
 --With पर्यव परि-अव, To endeavour, Naiṣ. 6, 23. पर्यवसित,
 1. Finished, Utt.
. With लोकान्तरम् Gone in another world, Utt.

.
 --With प्रत्यव प्रति-अव, प्रत्यवसित, [] Eaten.
 --With व्यव वि-अव,
 1. To effectuate, to be able,

. To reflect, Śāk. d. 115.
 5. To believe,
. To wish, Śāk. d. 17. Anomal. pres. सामि,

; potent. सेयम्, 1, 4163; fut. सिष्यामि, 1, 6118; absol. व्यवस्य, 1, 5926. व्यवसित,
 1. Resolved,

; endeavouring, Vikr. d. 125.
 3. Tricked, cheated. n. Certainty.
 --Caus. सायय, To embolden,
